proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b c p hc
  have ha : a ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) := subset_affineSpan ℝ _ (by simp)
  have key : p ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) ↔ ∃ s t : ℝ, p = a + s • (b - a) + t • (c - a) := by
    rw [← AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem ha p, direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℝ (show a ∈ ({a, b, c} : Set V) by simp)]
    simp only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, vsub_eq_sub, sub_self, Submodule.span_insert_zero, Submodule.mem_span_pair]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, t, h⟩; exact ⟨s, t, by rw [add_assoc, h]; abel⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, t, h⟩; exact ⟨s, t, by rw [h]; module⟩
  have hset : ({a, b, c, p} : Set V) = insert p {a, b, c} := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto
  rw [← key, hset]
  constructor
  · intro hcop
    have hind := affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set.mpr hc
    have hfin : FiniteDimensional ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (insert p {a, b, c} : Set V)) :=
      finiteDimensional_vectorSpan_of_finite ℝ (by simp)
    have hW : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V)) = 2 := by
      have := hind.finrank_vectorSpan (n := 2) (by simp)
      have hr : Set.range ![a, b, c] = ({a, b, c} : Set V) := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
          fin_cases i <;> simp
        · intro h
          simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
          rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl
          · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
      rwa [hr] at this
    have hle : vectorSpan ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) ≤ vectorSpan ℝ (insert p {a, b, c} : Set V) :=
      vectorSpan_mono ℝ (Set.subset_insert _ _)
    have hW' : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (insert p {a, b, c} : Set V)) ≤ 2 :=
      coplanar_iff_finrank_le_two.mp hcop
    have heq := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle (by omega)
    rw [← AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem ha p, direction_affineSpan, heq]
    exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ (by simp) (by simp)
  · intro hp
    exact (coplanar_insert_iff_of_mem_affineSpan hp).mpr (coplanar_triple ℝ a b c)
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a b c p : V), ¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) → (Coplanar ℝ ({a, b, c, p} : Set V) ↔ ∃ s t : ℝ, p = a + s • (b - a) + t • (c - a))
